External call registering the proposal on the DAO registry before any state effects in the adapter.

edges.reason: dao parameter is used inside submitProposal for registry and extension lookups.
proposalId parameter flows into dao.submitProposal and into the proposals mapping key.
applicant parameter flows into isNotReservedAddress, potentialNewMember and stored ProposalDetails.
nftAddr parameter is stored in the proposals mapping for later collection.
nftTokenId parameter is stored in the proposals mapping for later collection.
requestAmount parameter is stored in proposals and later credited to the applicant.
data parameter is forwarded to the voting adapter calls.
msg.sender is passed as the sender into getSenderAddress, influencing who sponsors the proposal.
submitProposal forwards the DAO submitProposal call to register the proposal.
msg.sender is supplied to votingContract.getSenderAddress to resolve the sponsor.
sponsoredBy is the value returned by the external getSenderAddress call.
submitProposal performs the external getSenderAddress call through votingContract.
submitProposal invokes potentialNewMember(applicant, dao, bank) to add the applicant as a member.
applicant parameter is passed into potentialNewMember, granting membership.
submitProposal writes the new ProposalDetails struct into the proposals mapping.
dao parameter is used inside processProposal to read proposal state and extensions.
proposalId parameter indexes the proposals mapping and DAO registry calls.
proposalId parameter reads ProposalDetails from the proposals mapping.
proposals mapping storage is loaded into the proposal local reference.
proposal values (nftAddr, nftTokenId, applicant, requestAmount) drive processProposal effects.
processProposal calls nftExt.collect which triggers erc721.safeTransferFrom callback into untrusted NFT contracts.
processProposal calls bank.addToBalance to credit UNITS to the applicant after proposal processing.
The NFT collect external call can re-enter before the bank balance is credited in addToBalance.
msg.sender is checked against the DAO lock and adapter/proposal ownership during processProposal.
voteResult local determines whether the mint and collect branch executes in processProposal.
dao parameter is used by configureDao for onlyAdapter checks and extension lookup.
configureDao calls bank.registerPotentialNewInternalToken(UNITS) to enable the internal token.
msg.sender is validated through onlyAdapter before configuration is applied.
